fire: On Friday the preschoolers made a leaf collage and hung it by the door.
During art time the kindergarteners painted their own rainbow fish.
In Room 4 the third graders built a cardboard castle for the medieval fair.
The nursery children are practising their nativity songs every morning this week.
For Mother's Day each first grader decorated a flower pot and planted a seed.
After snack the little ones glued cotton balls onto a paper sheep.
Our Year 2 class wrote their own poems about autumn and read them aloud.
The toddlers sorted buttons by colour and then made a button necklace.
quiet: On Friday the carpenters made a new door and hung it by the porch.
During the open day the gallery staff displayed their own landscape paintings.
In Hall 4 the contractors built a cardboard mock-up for the planning hearing.
The choir members are practising their carols every evening this week.
For the spring sale each volunteer decorated a flower pot and priced it.
After lunch the nurses sorted the supplies and restocked the cupboard.
Our editorial team wrote their own columns about autumn and published them online.
The jewellers sorted beads by colour and then strung a necklace.
